Title: Successful registration with valid data
Steps: Enter valid email; Enter valid password; Click Register

Title: Duplicate email submission
Steps: Enter existing email; Enter valid password; Click Register

Title: Empty required fields validation
Steps: Leave email blank; Leave password blank; Click Register
Expected Result: Inline validation errors shown; No API request sent

Title: Password minimum length (8 chars)
Steps: Enter valid email; Enter 8-char password; Click Register

Title: Password maximum length (64 chars)
Steps: Enter valid email; Enter 64-char password; Click Register

Title: Password too short (7 chars)
Steps: Enter valid email; Enter 7-char password; Click Register
Expected Result: Validation error: Password must be 8-64 chars

Title: Password too long (65 chars)
Steps: Enter valid email; Enter 65-char password; Click Register
Expected Result: Validation error: Password must be 8-64 chars

Title: Invalid email format
Steps: Enter invalid email; Enter valid password; Click Register

Title: Email with special characters
Steps: Enter email with + symbol; Enter valid password; Click Register

Title: Registration with mixed case email
Steps: Enter mixed case email; Enter valid password; Click Register
Expected Result: Account created; Email stored as provided or normalized
